=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1526-1560 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The stall warning (lines 1559-1560) uses the cached `IMPL_RUN_STATUS` (lines 1526, 1607-1609), while the `stall-diag latest-run` line (1544) prints a freshly fetched status, so the two can contradict.
  WHY: If the run moves from pending to in_progress after the last refresh, the log says in_progress and then warns the run "never started". This only affects diagnostic text. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1532-1535 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `gh api` calls in `log_implement_stall_diagnostics` have no comment recording which existing calls were audited, as §14 requires.
  WHY: This is a documentation gap only. The calls are fail-open and run once on the stall exit. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- changelog.d/8376-implement-stall-diagnostics.md:8 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says the in-progress read shows a pre-window run holding the concurrency group. The read is `GET /actions/runs?status=in_progress` (test-and-mark-stable.yml:1556), so it misses holders in `pending`/`queued`/`waiting`.
  WHY: If the concurrency holder is itself stuck in `pending`/`queued`, the diagnostics print `stall-diag in-progress-run: none`, and operators may wrongly conclude nothing held the group. Rated NIT.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: `log_implement_stall_diagnostics`, final `if` that echoes the "never started" warning | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The warning uses the cached `IMPL_RUN_STATUS` from the last progress-counter refresh. The function also prints the run's current status in the `stall-diag latest-run:` line, and the two can disagree.
  WHY: If the run moves from pending to in_progress after the last refresh, the log shows in_progress and then warns the run never started. This only affects diagnostic text.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml: comment above `log_implement_stall_diagnostics` (HARDENING_SUGGESTION) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: §14 asks that new `gh api` calls document which existing calls were audited. The comment does not say the existing progress-counter and jobs reads cover only the scoped run and cannot show other in-progress runs or a concurrency holder.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to add 1-2 comment lines saying this, and noting the calls run once on the stall exit only. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1559-1560 vs 1544 and 1526/1607-1608 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "never started" `::warning::` uses the cached `IMPL_RUN_STATUS`, which refreshes only every 30 seconds, while the preceding `stall-diag latest-run` line prints a freshly fetched status.
  WHY: If the run moves pending → in_progress during the last refresh window, the log is self-contradictory and misleads the operator.
- changelog.d/8376-implement-stall-diagnostics.md:8 vs .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1556 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fragment says the in-progress read shows a pre-window run holding the concurrency group. The read is `GET /actions/runs?status=in_progress` (test-and-mark-stable.yml:1556), which excludes `pending`/`queued`/`waiting` runs; the window read at 1553 also filters by `created=>`.
  WHY: If the concurrency holder is stuck in `pending`/`queued`, as in run 40876853022, the diagnostics print `stall-diag in-progress-run: none` and the fragment's stated guarantee does not hold.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1532-1535, 1543, 1546, 1553, 1556 (HARDENING_SUGGESTION) | severity=NIT
  PROBLEM: The four new `gh api` calls lack the §14 audit note naming which existing calls were considered and why they cannot supply this data.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to add 1-2 comment lines at the function. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1559-1560 (HARDENING_SUGGESTION) | severity=NIT
  PROBLEM: The warning's "never started" claim rests on the 30-second-stale `IMPL_RUN_STATUS`, which can contradict the freshly fetched status printed two lines earlier.
  WHY: Suggested fix is to reword the warning to say the status was current at the last poll, or to gate it on the freshly fetched status in `stall_diag_out`. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
